fields.statement: Verifier at 49149bb7a: read the diff (parseCICauses beside parseFailedTests in internal/api/ship.go, wired into shipReadFailures and shipInfraWait; --test-failures and findings descriptions name the causes; fmt header matches the Makefile's 'unformatted files:'). go test -trimpath ./internal/api/ -run 'TestParseCICauses|TestShipCheckCIFindingsNonTest|TestShipInfraWaitSettlesOnCause' -v -count=1: all three PASS. They cover gh job/step/timestamp-prefixed logs: a self-check log with two 'fail render docs/reference/...' lines plus 'make: *** [Makefile:186: self-check] Error 1' becomes one finding named 'lint / Run make lint: self-check' quoting the fail lines; a fmt-check listing; a go vet 'x.go:12:3:' diagnostic; a bare 'make: *** [build] Error 2' with the lines before it; apt 'Temporary failure resolving', billing and failing-test logs give no cause. Ship check with a fake gh records the finding in ci_findings; --test-failures exits 0 on it and 1 on the infra log; --settled --changed --rerun-infra settles on an attempt with a recognised cause. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/describe-golden -count=1: ok (golden regenerated). go test -trimpath -timeout 45m ./internal/api/...: every test passed (no '--- FAIL'); the package exited 1 only on the rootguard check, because .rhiza-root/usage.live.json changed, which the live root daemon writes and rootguard does not list as owned; this predates the leaf, is unrelated to its diff, and is filed as draft change set 01M76J4VQ6PMFR6T23Y957E8HK (discovered-from). The first run without -timeout hit go test's 10m default under host load ~12.
